# Global Strategic Technologies (GST)

> M&A technical due diligence, post-acquisition integration and platform modernization advisory for private equity investors and portfolio executives. Led by Reid Peryam.

GST publishes free browser-based diligence tools, a reference library, and an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes the same engines to AI agents. Access to the MCP server is operator-provisioned; the documentation is public.

## MCP Server

- [MCP Server overview](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/mcp/): what the server exposes, access tiers, and how to request a credential
- [Capability reference](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/mcp/docs/): every tool, prompt and resource family, with arguments, an example call and what comes back. Renders fully without JavaScript
- [Get started](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/mcp/get-started/): connect Claude Desktop or another MCP client and verify the connection
- [Using the server](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/mcp/using/): a first query, prompt argument forms, pinned resources, and what each failure means
- [Advanced operations](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/mcp/advanced-operations/): the information request list ingestion workflow
- Endpoint: https://mcp.globalstrategic.tech/mcp (Streamable HTTP, bearer or OAuth; a credential is required)
- Status: https://status.mcp.globalstrategic.tech/

## Tools

- [Tools index](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/)
- [The Diligence Machine](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/diligence-machine/): a technology diligence agenda customized to a target profile
- [Technical Debt Cost Calculator](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/tech-debt-calculator/): annual carrying cost of technical debt
- [TechPar](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/techpar/): technology cost ratio benchmarked against stage-adjusted ranges
- [Infrastructure Cost Governance](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/infrastructure-cost-governance/): cloud cost maturity assessment
- [Regulatory Map](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/regulatory-map/): global data privacy and AI regulation map
- [Information Request List Generator](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/information-request-list-generator/): fillable .xlsx information request list
- [Information Request List Extractor](https://globalstrategic.tech/hub/tools/information-request-list-extractor/): filled workbook to canonical markdown, in the browser
